simple.meaning: כַּרְמִי (Karmîy) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Joshua, 1 Chronicles, beginning at Genesis 46:9. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, family line, firstborn, Israel.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows כַּרְמִי through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
